title: Slovakian Broccoli Fritters with French Twist
description: A crispy and earthy take on traditional Slovakian fritters, inspired by French cuisine. This dish combines the flavors of broccoli and curry with a crunchy exterior.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine broccoli florets, Slovakian rye flour, curry powder, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk together crisp vegetable oil and egg.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Using a spoon or a cookie scoop, drop small balls of dough into hot oil and flatten slightly.
Cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Drain fritters on paper towels and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
